subject: Chargeback notification + next steps to update card on file
messages:
From: Jill Turner <billing@acmesupply.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice INV-4582 — chargeback posted

Hi Rachel,

We received a notice from our card provider that a chargeback was issued against the payment for Redwood invoice INV-4582 (Feb 26, 2026). The transaction shows as disputed in our online banking and our accounting team requested we flag it to you so we can resolve quickly.

A few details from our side: card ending in 4023, posted amount $12,500.00, dispute reason listed as "unauthorized transaction." We didn't initiate a refund and the cardholder is on our AP team.

Can you confirm whether this was a legitimate charge on your end? If so, please send evidence (invoice, signed SOW, delivery confirmation) and let us know the best way to get the card updated on file.

Appreciate a quick turnaround — our renewal window is coming up and we want to avoid any service interruption.

Thanks,
Jill Turner\Billing Operations\Acme Supply Co.
attachments: invoice_202602_INV-4582.pdf

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 10:05:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice INV-4582 — chargeback posted

Hi Jill — thanks for the heads up and sorry for the trouble. We see the same charge in Stripe (charge_0A1B2C) for $12,500 on 2026-02-26. We did receive a signed SOW and the services were provisioned; I attached the invoice and the signed SOW for your records.

Internal plan: I'm looping in Marcus (finance) and Evelyn (AR) to review evidence for a dispute, and Vivek from payments to help with the card-on-file update flow. Marcus/Evelyn — can you confirm if we should proceed with filing a dispute with Stripe or accept reversal and retry the card?

Jill, for card updates we can:
- Share a secure card-update link (PCI-compliant) that will generate a new token in Stripe
- Or accept a PO or alternate payment method for the short term while the dispute is handled

I'll follow up with the Stripe evidence packet and the dispute case id once Marcus confirms.

Best,
Rachel Kim\Account Executive, Strategic Accounts\Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>

Thanks Rachel. I pulled the ledger and verified the charge_id charge_0A1B2C and the matching invoice INV-4582. We have:
- Signed SOW (attached to thread)
- Delivery notes (services activated, usage logs)
- Payment attempt succeeded on 2026-02-26 per Stripe

Recommendation: we should lodge a dispute with Stripe immediately and submit the following evidence: signed SOW, invoice, delivery/activation logs, and customer correspondence acknowledging provisioning. Vivek — can you assemble the Stripe dispute packet and take the lead filing? If Stripe requires additional signed receipts, I can pull the contract references.

Also flagging possibility: if the cardholder insists, Acme may still process a chargeback. If that happens we'll rely on Stripe's dispute timeline. In parallel, Rachel, offer Acme a secure card-update link or ACH as a short-term route to re-attempt payment so services remain uninterrupted.

Marcus Lin\Finance Manager\Redwood Inference

On Tue, Mar 2, 2026 at 11:22 AM Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Recommendation: we should lodge a dispute with Stripe immediately and submit the following evidence...

Done — I opened a dispute with Stripe this morning. Case ID: DSP_0A1B2C. I uploaded the invoice, signed SOW (signed_sof_acme.pdf), activation logs and the Stripe charge screenshot. I also included the last three support emails to show the customer acknowledged provisioning. Stripe confirmed receipt and requested any additional correspondence within 7 days.

Separately I created a secure card update link for Acme (PCI tokenizes directly to Stripe). Link: https://payments.redwood.ai/card-update/hs-987654 (expire 48h). Suggested note for the customer: "Use this secure link to update the card on file; we will re-attempt the charge once authorized."

I'll monitor the dispute and escalate with Stripe if they request more evidence. Marcus/Evelyn, I left notes in the case about expected refund hold if the dispute goes through.

-Vivek
Payments Ops\Redwood Inference

Hi Jill — quick update: we have opened a dispute with Stripe (DSP_0A1B2C) and submitted the invoice, signed SOW, activation logs and correspondence as evidence. Vivek also generated a secure card-update link for your AP team to use: https://payments.redwood.ai/card-update/hs-987654 (expires in 48 hours).

If Acme can update the card and authorize a retry, we can attempt to reprocess the transaction to cover the outstanding balance while the dispute is active — this will minimize any risk of service interruption. If you'd prefer ACH/PO for the short term, we can accept a remittance and mark the invoice as pending in our system.

Please confirm which option works for you and I'll coordinate next steps. Thanks for flagging this quickly.

Best regards,
